thesis: News is why stocks move, but "tracking real-time news" is three different games and only one is open to a retail operator on a Railway poller. (a) Racing headlines in seconds-to-30-minutes is lost before it starts: machine-readable feeds reach co-located systems in milliseconds, the 8-K is filed 1-30 min after the wire, a Python poller sees EDGAR 10-60 s after acceptance, and this project's three intraday tests (100 live days -0.23R; 753k bars -0.07R gross; biggest gap-ups negative in both windows) are the empirical version of that fact. (b) Classifying the TYPE of catalyst over hours-to-weeks is the open game and the one thing untested here: the literature says news-driven moves continue while no-news moves revert (Chan 2003; Tetlock 2010), PEAD is the most replicated short-horizon continuation (day 1 to 60, small/mid caps, weak in large caps since ~2010), guidance is its strongest component, offerings/restatements are followed by underperformance, FDA/M&A are binary and priced at the print. "Gap >= 8% on 3x volume" mixes types with opposite hazards; the earnings half of the type test is already on disk (196k 8-K 2.02 filings with exact acceptance timestamps). Honest expectation: small per-event effect (tens of bp/week net), largest where spreads are widest, shrinking; the most valuable output is likely exclusions (no-news moves, dilution, restatements) rather than a standalone long, and v5's own slice hinted earnings-tagged E1 overnight events are worse, so PEAD must be tested as a multi-day object, not an overnight one. (c) No-news reversal is a filter, not a trade: never enter a continuation position on a move with no 8-K, press release or calendar event in [T-1, T]. Conclusion: real-time news is not the best way to FIND momentum in minutes; it is the only route left in this project to CONDITION the overnight/multi-day trade on a mechanism, and the decisive experiment costs nothing (design written to C:/Users/ravee/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-ravee-OneDrive-Documents-Claude-Projects-Trader-v3/78b21416-ab81-443d-91e4-e5b336ec1c07/scratchpad/research/NEWSARCH_design.md).

who_wins_at_each_horizon: 0-60 s: HFT and machine-readable-feed readers; retail cannot compete on latency or spread. 1-30 min: pro desks and prop algos reading the release; retail loses because first prints revert (this project: 100 live days -0.23R/trade, 753k bars -0.07R gross). Rest of session: nobody reliably; reversal dominates (gap-ups held: next session -0.22%). Close -> next open: overnight flow, regime-dependent; auction fills are fine for retail but the effect existed only 2020-2024 (E1 +0.79% seen, -0.38% in 2004-2013, verdict RED). Day 1 -> day 5-60 (PEAD, guidance, analyst drift): patient cost-disciplined capital and small-cap specialists; the only horizon where a Railway poller with once-a-day auction decisions has no structural disadvantage; capacity is small but irrelevant to a retail sleeve; UNTESTED in this project (the multi-day family was tested only unconditionally on price/volume). Weeks-months: fundamental/thematic investors (already the Themes service). Backtest clock rule everywhere: only EDGAR acceptance time (ET, DST-correct) defines "known by"; before 09:30 -> same session is day 0; 09:30-16:00 -> flag intraday, next session is day 0; after 16:00 -> next session is day 0; acceptance >= 17:30 keeps next-day filing date but the wire had it at once.
classification_design: Two stages, one frozen schema. Stage 1 (smallest model) on headline + first ~1,500 chars of every deduped universe item; Stage 2 (larger model) on full EX-99.1/PR text only for names reaching a decision time, with supplied context (FMP consensus EPS/revenue, prior guidance, market cap, ADV, next scheduled earnings) so the model never relies on memory for numbers. Schema (enums frozen before any test; a change = new classifier_version): event_id, ticker, cik, doc_kind {8-K, PR, headline, halt}; event_type {earnings_results, guidance_only, preannouncement, analyst_action, m_and_a_target, m_and_a_acquirer, deal_terminated, equity_offering, convertible_or_debt, buyback_or_dividend, fda_or_clinical, contract_award, index_change, management_change, restatement_nonreliance, legal_regulatory, going_concern_or_delisting_notice, reverse_split, activist_or_13d, insider_transaction, macro_or_sector, other, none}; direction -2..+2 (read of the news, not the price); magnitude {small <3%, medium 3-10%, large >10%}; novelty {scheduled, unscheduled}; already_preannounced bool; guidance_changed {raised, lowered, maintained, initiated, withdrawn, none}; eps_vs_consensus / revenue_vs_consensus {beat, miss, inline, unknown} from supplied numbers; dilution_flag bool + dilution_pct_of_mktcap + offering_kind {registered, direct, atm, pipe, convertible}; binary_event_ahead bool + kind + date (<=30 d); promotional_flag bool; confidence 0-1; evidence_quote <=25 words verbatim; rationale one sentence. Few-shot policy: 10-14 fixed exemplars incl. hard negatives ("record revenue" with lowered guidance = net negative; "strategic alternatives" = other/0/binary ahead; "registered direct offering at a discount" = dilution; ATM program = small dilution; preannounced beat; Reg FD 7.01 investor day = guidance_only); temperature 0; structured output enforced; prompt+exemplars hashed into classifier_version; no edits inside a test window. Validation in order: (1) 8-K item-code agreement as coarse ground truth (2.02 earnings/guidance; 1.01 deal/contract/M&A; 3.02 offering; 5.02 management; 4.02 restatement; 5.03 reverse split; 1.03 bankruptcy; 3.01 delisting; 7.01 guidance) target >=90% where unambiguous, disagreements hand-audited; (2) numeric fidelity vs XBRL/FMP actuals and a 200-doc hand set; hallucinated fields are dropped from any rule, not patched; (3) stability: re-classify 500 docs, label agreement >=95%, direction within +/-1 in >=98%; (4) time split: prompt frozen on 2024-09..2025-08 docs, statistics reported on 2025-09..2026-09; (5) forward-return validation is the only one that matters: excess return by (type, direction, guidance_changed) WITHIN day-0 return buckets vs matched no-news names, never "does direction predict the day-0 sign". Volume/cost (tokens as the unit; confirm dollar prices on the current Anthropic pricing page): normal day 300-600 8-Ks (150-300 after universe filter) plus 2-5k headlines collapsing to a few hundred after dedupe; Stage 1 ~0.3-0.8M input tokens/day, Stage 2 on 20-60 docs ~0.3-0.7M; peak earnings days x4; order of magnitude low single-digit dollars/day at the smallest tier, tens on peak days with a large Stage-2 model. Historical labelling: ~20k EX-99.1 docs 2024-09..2026-09 (~160M tokens) or, first, the ~4-6k with |day-0 excess| >=5% (~40M tokens).
tradeable_shapes: N1 Chan test (decisive): day-0 excess >= +8% (second row >= +3% with vol >= 2x), split by has-2.02-filing-with-day0=T vs no 8-K of any item in [T-1,T]; entries MOC T and MOO T+1 (sub-cells); exits close T+1, T+5, T+20 (time only); pass = news minus no-news difference >= +0.50% at T+5 and >= +1.0% at T+20 net with lower CI > 0 in BOTH confirmatory windows (2022-2026 and 2004-2013), vs SPY and vs matched controls C2

N2 PEAD long-only: earnings day 0 (2.02), day-0 excess in the top decile of that day's earnings names (min +5%), ADV >= $50M; entries MOO T+1 and MOC T+1 (MOC T+1 favoured since the project's evidence says the T+1 session reverts); exits close T+5/T+10/T+20/T+40; pass = excess >= +0.75% at T+20 with lower CI > +0.40% (multi-day survivorship haircut) and C2 lower CI > 0, >= 60% quarters positive, n >= 300

N3 Guidance-raised: N2 event AND guidance_changed = raised AND not already_preannounced (needs LLM labels on EX-99.1, 2024-09..2026-09 only); same entries/exits as N2; reported as a discovery cell, not promotable until a 2027+ live window exists
N4 Earnings-overnight: v5 E1/E2 with 2.02 day 0 = T vs E1/E2 with no 8-K; MOC T -> MOO T+1; same v5 pass criteria; registered for completeness, expected to fail (v5 slice hinted earnings E1 is worse)

N5 Negative-type exclusions: 3.02/424B5 offerings, 4.02 restatements, 5.03 reverse splits, 3.01 delisting notices, 1.03 bankruptcy, going-concern language -> 60-day exclusion applied to every long cell if it raises the cell's excess with a non-overlapping CI; otherwise dropped
N6 Analyst actions and index adds (FMP grades-historical, index announcements): MOC T -> close T+5/T+20; deferred until N1/N2 resolve (no timestamped history on disk; survivorship in FMP grades)

Sizing if anything passes: fixed sleeve S, 5% of S per position, <= 6 concurrent, per-name cap 3xATR20 <= 2% of S, skip entries when SPY <= -3% on T, no entry if a scheduled binary event (earnings, PDUFA, court date, vote) falls inside the hold horizon, half weights for the first 100 events, v5 drawdown ladder (halve at -6% of S, stop at -10%)
Explicitly excluded by the project's evidence: any intraday technical entry or exit, price targets, stops, holds opened from the next open without a registered multi-day cell
backtest_design: Universe prior close >= $5, ADV20 >= $50M through T-1; costs 5 bp/side (ADV20 >= $100M) else 10 bp; benchmarks SPY over the identical leg AND matched non-event names C2 (nearest 5 by day-0 excess return in the same liquidity decile, fixed seed) which is the "news or the move?" test; day- and quarter-cluster bootstrap, wider CI reported; Holm within each declared family; survivorship haircut +0.25% (overnight) / +0.40% (multi-day); every extra variant logged to things_tried.csv with who=NEWSARCH. Windows: discovery 2014-09..2021-12; confirmatory, run once with frozen thresholds and SHA-256'd NEWSARCH_prereg.json: (i) 2022-01..2026-09 (spliced 10y+2y panels; 7-day hole descriptive only) and (ii) 2004-2013 (1,225 names; item codes from 2004-08; decompose the 29% earnings coverage into true non-earnings share vs archive gaps). Pass requires both confirmatory windows (the v5 lesson: 2020-2024 alone proves nothing). Steps: (1) event table from the five jsonl files: one row per (cik, ticker, accession) with acc_et, session bucket BMO/intraday/AMC, day0 from the SPY calendar, item set; CIK->ticker via company_tickers.json, log multi-ticker CIKs and filers with no bars (a direct measure of the missing population); merge on (ticker, day0); coverage by year and panel. (2) Re-run sec_sub_fetch.py keeping every 8-K/8-K/A regardless of items (~40 min) for the no-8-K arm and the N5 tables. (3) Discovery run of N1, N2, N4 with all sub-cells and C2 controls; fix thresholds; write the prereg with the exact Holm family count {N1 x 3 horizons x 2 entries, N2 x 4 x 2, N4 x 2}. (4) Confirmatory run once; independent verifier re-derives n and point estimates from raw files as in v5. (5) LLM labels on EX-99.1 for 2.02 filings 2024-09..2026-09 with |day-0 excess| >= 5% (~4-6k docs) -> classifier validation -> N3 as a discovery cell only. (6) Placebos: event date shifted +/-1 session (should destroy N1/N2), mirror events (day-0 <= -8% with vs without news), liquidity terciles, earnings-season vs off-season. Decision rule: if news-conditioned movers do not beat matched no-news movers net at T+5 or T+20 in both confirmatory windows, the answer is "news explains the moves but does not make them tradeable at retail costs on this data" and only live logging remains.
realtime_pipeline: Separate Railway service, no shared code with the scanner or Themes. Flow: pollers -> normalize -> dedupe -> classify(1) -> enrich -> candidates -> classify(2) -> rank -> decision times -> tickets -> log. Ingest: EDGAR getcurrent Atom every 30 s (06:00-22:00 ET; the 06:00 burst is the after-17:30 backlog, not fresh news); four wire RSS feeds every 60 s; FMP press-releases-latest and stock-latest every 5 min; Finnhub company-news only for already-flagged names (60/min budget); Nasdaq/NYSE halt feeds every 30 s; earnings calendar and FMP estimates at 05:30 ET; prices from the existing 15:44 batch snapshot and end-of-day bars; persistent cursors on the volume so restarts never replay or skip. Normalize: ticker via CIK map for EDGAR, symbol tags for FMP/Finnhub, wire items by exchange:ticker parse else fuzzy company-name match with a confidence field; universe filter; foreign issuers dropped. Dedupe: canonical key = 8-K accession when present, else sha1(ticker + normalized headline) within 12 h; a PR and its later 8-K are linked (same ticker, title similarity >= 0.8, 8-K within 4 h) keeping the earliest public time as source_time and acceptance as edgar_time. Classify(1) on every deduped item; enrich with day-0 return so far, gap, RVOL, ADV, market cap, halt state, days to next earnings; candidates = items meeting a registered cell's event definition; classify(2) on full text for candidates only. Rank: only the registered rule's own ordering (day-0 excess descending within the cell), capped by concurrency; no composite score, no discretion. Decision times: 09:20 ET build the MOO list from overnight/06:00 events (tickets by 09:28); 15:44 ET build the MOC list from the batch snapshot (tickets by 15:49 NYSE / 15:54 Nasdaq); exits are time-based and generated the night before; nothing else fires. Halted (T1/T12/LUDP) at a decision time = skip; halted while held = exit at the first decision time after resumption. Tickets: phase 1 a message with the exact ticket the operator submits; phase 2 (after the pilot) broker-API auto-submit with a kill switch. Log written before any ticket is sent.
operator_loop: 08:30 ET (5 min): read the overnight event list and Stage-2 outputs; mark classifier errors (they become golden-set data). 09:20-09:28: submit MOO tickets if any. 15:40-15:49: submit MOC tickets if any. After the close: automatic backfill of fills and returns, one-line summary. Weekly (20 min): audit 20 random classifications; review dedupe misses; CUSUM of realized vs registered expectation per cell; latency histogram source_time -> first_seen (if latency ever appears to matter for a cell, that cell is measuring the racing game and is dropped). Monthly: recompute registered statistics on the live log only; prompt/model version decisions, never silent, each re-validated on the 300-doc golden set. Quarterly: continue / halve / stop per the drawdown ladder. Vetoes and any off-rule trades are logged separately from rule decisions.
what_to_log: Per event from day one. Identity and timing: event_id, ticker, CIK, exchange, doc_kind, source, URL/accession, item codes, source_time, edgar_time, first_seen (our poller), classified_at (both stages), decision_time, after-17:30 dissemination flag, earnings-calendar expected session vs actual. Content: raw text or EX-99.1 path and hash, headline, full Stage-1 and Stage-2 JSON, classifier_version, model id, prompt hash, token counts, cost. Market context as of the decision time then backfilled: prior close, open, 15:44 last, close, next open, next close, closes at +5/+10/+20/+40, SPY at the same points, ADV20, market cap, gap %, RVOL at 15:44 and close, halt codes and times, days to next scheduled earnings, any scheduled binary event inside 40 days, auction spread if the broker reports it. Decision: which registered cells fired (all cells evaluated in parallel as shadow columns so every cell accumulates live evidence at once), rank, the ticket that would be or was sent, submitted yes/no and why not (cutoff missed, halt, concurrency cap, operator veto), fill price and slippage vs the official auction print, realized excess per horizon. Null events: every universe name with |day-0 excess| >= 5% and no linked news, logged with the same context (the free no-news arm).
risks_and_failure_modes: Latency arbitrage: anything whose payoff depends on being first belongs to co-located feed readers; the design permits only auction-time decisions, and a cell that looks latency-sensitive live is dropped as a racing-game artefact
Classification drift: model or prompt changes silently shift labels; pinned model id, hashed prompt, 300-document golden-set regression on every version change, no changes inside a test window

Survivorship in news archives: FMP/Finnhub histories exist only for surviving tickers and the ticker list is as of 2026-09; EDGAR CIKs do not forget delisted filers, so log filers-with-filings-but-no-bars as a direct measure of the missing population and apply the haircut

Costs in small caps: PEAD lives where spreads are 30-100 bp; MOC/MOO fills reduce but do not remove this; report liquidity terciles and treat an effect that exists only below $100M ADV as probably not net positive

Halts: T1 at the open means no MOO fill or a fill at the reopening price; LULD pauses after news; H10 SEC suspensions can last days; rule is skip if halted at decision time, exit at the next decision time after resumption, log every case

Holding into binary events: earnings inside a 20-40 day hold, PDUFA dates, court rulings, votes; binary_event_ahead flag plus calendar exclusion, applied identically in the backtest or its returns overstate

Timestamp lies and dedupe misses: aggregator times, date-only items, ticker collisions (parent/subsidiary, SPAC renames, share classes); backtest clock is EDGAR acceptance only; live logs keep every timestamp so the gap is measurable

LLM numeric hallucination: supplied consensus numbers, mandatory verbatim evidence quotes, numeric fields cross-checked against XBRL/FMP actuals; a field failing the check is excluded from any rule rather than patched
Regime dependence: the 2020-2024 anomaly will reappear in any news-conditioned cell; both confirmatory windows (2022-2026 and 2004-2013) are required and a 2022-2026-only pass is AMBER at best
Schema drift as multiple testing: every new event_type or threshold after the freeze is a new test, logged to things_tried.csv and counted in the Holm family
Earnings-overnight prior is weak: v5's own slice hinted earnings-tagged E1 events were worse overnight, so the earnings edge if any is multi-day and must not be sold as an overnight trade

Operational: EDGAR 10 req/s limit and User-Agent requirement, wire RSS terms of use, Railway restarts (persistent cursors), the 17:30 dissemination wall producing a 06:00 backlog burst, Finnhub 60/min and 1-year limits, and the operator trading an exciting headline off-rule (vetoes and off-rule trades logged separately)
build_plan: Step 1 (free, 1-2 sessions of compute, no LLM): N1 Chan test and N2 PEAD on data already on disk. Build the event table from the 2.02 archive with ET/DST-correct session mapping, discovery 2014-09..2021-12, freeze thresholds in NEWSARCH_prereg.json (SHA-256), single confirmatory run on 2022-2026 and 2004-2013 with matched controls, independent verifier. This is the decisive experiment: if news-conditioned movers do not beat matched no-news movers net at T+5 or T+20 in both windows, the operator's question is answered (news explains moves, does not make them tradeable at retail costs) and only live logging remains

Step 2 (~40 min fetch): re-run sec_sub_fetch.py keeping all 8-K items to get the true no-8-K arm of N1 and the N5 exclusion tables (3.02, 4.02, 5.03, 3.01, 1.03); re-run N1/N2 with exclusions as the single pre-declared variant

Step 3 (only if step 1 is not RED on both N1 and N2; ~40M input tokens): download EX-99.1 for 2.02 filings 2024-09..2026-09 with |day-0 excess| >= 5% (~4-6k docs), classify with the frozen schema, validate per the item-code / numeric / stability / time-split protocol, run N3 (guidance raised) as a discovery cell; confirm current model pricing before budgeting

Step 4 (start now regardless of steps 1-3; costs only a poller): logging-only real-time service on Railway: ingest, dedupe, Stage-1 classification, halt tracking, null events, all shadow cells; no notifications, no capital; 60 days minimum; report latency, dedupe rate, classifier agreement with item codes, live vs backtest event frequency. This is v5's 'cheapest honest next step' and makes a 2027 regime-aware test possible on lived data

Step 5: shadow decisions for any GREEN cell from step 1 (or AMBER after 12 months of step-4 data), then half-weight pilot for 100 events, then full weights under the drawdown ladder and CUSUM monitors (the v5 promotion path unchanged)

Step 6 (only after step 5): analyst actions and index adds (N6), broker-API auto-submit with kill switch, Stage-2 on a larger model, paid news feeds only if a passed cell proves latency-sensitive (by design it should not)
